correctness.rationale: Complete all-parameter proof identifies all directed cycles, conditions exact coloring probabilities, and derives polynomial identity. P prime at one fixes c, cyclotomic multiplicities plus finite Möbius inversion exactly recover the unordered forward lengths, and indegree/outdegree identifies unique terminals. Strict logarithmic derivative gives unique simple (0,1) root for even r and none for odd r. Direct positive derivative yields strict normalized monotonicity for x>1. Standalone independent enumerative and exact integer checks pass, but no finite computation is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recent source specifically studies dichromatic polynomial uniqueness and poses its monotonicity conjecture. The coherent multi-theta class is a natural infinite strongly connected series-parallel network family whose entire shape is recoverable from a single polynomial; exactly enumerating isomorphism classes, giving a sharp root parity dichotomy, and proving monotonicity for all x>1 together answer structural questions beyond a generic inclusion-exclusion specialization. The result asserts no global uniqueness or unconditional general conjecture resolution.
